The CLI is used for extracting user-selected PKG files. The build is trimmed
to the CLI target and its required Crypto++/zlib dependencies. Local Windows
compatibility adjustments: src/common/io_file.cpp uses CreateFileMappingW,
available in MinGW and Windows SDKs, and the CMake target links ntdll for
NtSetInformationFile.
